programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: The Evil Island Of Dr. B
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl. This battle won't be s

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson recuperates in the hospital after being rescued from the island where he fought Team Psykick. Away from school, Tyson discovers he really likes hospital life until Hilary shows up with all his homework assignments. Meanwhile Gideon, frustrated with his attempts to capture the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts, hatches a sinister new plan. He demands that Doctor B and his team create powerful Cyber Bit Beasts using the data they have gathered on the Blade Breakers. The only problem is their data is incomplete.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E63 The Other Side of the Gateway [English Dub]
programme.desc: When the battle ends, the one known as Father meets his final fate beyond the Gateway. When the one known as Fullmetal enters the sacred space, he finds only the promise of a new beginning.

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene le confiesa a Carlos que está enamorada de Leonardo y que espera que algún día Leonardo se dé cuenta que Alejandra es una mala persona. Alejandra y Rodrigo discuten por el dinero que perdieron y piensan en nuevos planes para destruir a los Ferrándiz. Leo les plantea a sus amigos que le va a reclamar a su papá la herencia de su madre para poder irse a vivir solo, Leonardo se entera de esto y le comenta que no hay ninguna herencia, Leo por supuesto no le cree. Irene descubre a su madre Trinidad llorando y ésta le confiesa un secreto terrible el cual le pide que no se lo cuente a Maria Lucia. Leonardo intenta reunir a su familia nuevamente para cena r y poder terminar de comentarles su idea de matrimonio.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 94: Barbara se Casa, Manuel Sufre
programme.desc: Salvador lleva a Bárbara al altar; Manuel sufre en la puerta de la iglesia. Cuando el padre pregunta si alguien se opone, Barbie mira hacia atrás esperando encontrar a Manuel, pero en vista de que no aparece es ella misma quien le dice al padre que continúe que nadie se opondrá. Bárbara se casa. Salvador se ve con Manuel después de la boda y le asegura que su hermana sigue enamorada de él.Durante la recepción Charo busca a Manuel, pero no lo encuentra. Fernando sigue a Charo hasta la habitación y hacen el amor. Luego, Fernando se marcha arrepentido por lo que acabó de pasar.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 94: El fantasma de la tia Laura.
programme.desc: Isadora brinda con Marisela y piensa que el hijo de Gabriel no nacerá. Una vez aclarado los puntos, Gabriel acepta quedarse en casa de Yolanda. Mirna y Reynaldo conversan de sus amores. Jesús va a buscar a Mirna. Víctor Manuel llora junto a su abuela por su mala vida y el está feliz de que ella sea su abuela pero no de su madre a quien no perdona. Cuando Isadora intenta agredir a Marisela una fuerte brisa hace que no brinden e Isadora ve a su difunta tía Laura, esto la aterra y se va corriendo creyendo que está loca. Flavia va al bar a buscar a Ramón, quien la recuerda. Abril cree que no es bueno estar en casa de sus padres pues no quiere pelear con su papá pues Ramón no la acepta y Berta se lo reclama entre llanto.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 137: Dileidi, Luis Fernando y el divorcio.
programme.desc: Gladis encuentra a su hija despidiendo a Aureliano muy alegre y le comenta que ella pensaba que la iba a encontrar muriéndose y Dileidi en ese momento rompe a llorar y abraza a Gladis diciéndole que si se está muriendo porque su novio acaba de casarse. Aureliano que llego a la bodega les cuenta tanto a Gabito como a Héctor como fue al rescate de Dileidi en la fiesta y como quedo como héroe. Dileidi le cuenta a Gladis que ella está muy mal porque sabe que su novio Luís Fernando se caso con la miss por compromiso y que se fue a la luna de miel muy afligido, pero Gladis le dice que eso no es como ella cree y no puede creer que Dileidi siendo tan inteligente se comporte de esa forma que no quiera entender lo que en realidad está pasando. Por otro lado, María Gracia llega a la habitación muy sexy y encuentra a Luís Fernando muy distraído, Luís Fernando vuelve en si y la ve así, pero María Gracia le dice que se siente muy mal, con nauseas y cansada y le pide disculpa a Luís Fernando porque ella lo único que quiere es dormir. Luís Fernando como un caballero le dice que no se preocupe, aunque lo que piensa es que malo comenzar un matrimonio así. Cristinita, Felicita y Tatianita que están en casa de Egleé comiendo torta y lamentándose por el casamiento de Luís Fernando, son interrumpida por la llega de Egleé y Santiago. Felicita y Tatianita opinan entonces tendrán que fijarse en Santiago que está soltero pero Cristinita les cuenta que Santiago es gay y tanto Felicita y Tatianita no lo pueden creer. Aristigueta y La Nena que llegaron también de la fiesta comentan sobre la misma. Aristigueta aprovecha para hablar de María José y Doroteo. La Nena se altera sobre algunos comentarios que hace y Aristigueta le opina que ella lo que está es celosa porque Doroteo anda con María José. La Nena se molesta aún más y le dice que ella no está celosa pero que debe recordar que Doroteo sigue siendo su marido legalmente y le da pena con sus amigos. María José y Doroteo conversan sobre Aristigueta y la Nena. María José se entera del papel que vio Doroteo en donde aparecen los terrenos y firmados por la Nena. María Antonia se da cuenta del error que cometió Aristigueta y le dice a Doroteo que como el sigue siendo esposo de La Nena entonces le pertenece la mitad de lo que le pertenece a la Nena en esos terrenos. Doroteo se alegra por esa información. Egleé se siente triste en el desayuno porque no se encuentra con Luís Fernando y se lo hace saber tanto a Gladis que llego como a Cristinita. Marco Aurelio en el trabajo le habla a Dileidi de Luís Fernando sin querer, es después que se da cuenta que hizo mal y le pide a Dileidi que no vaya a llorar y que lo perdone. Dileidi le hace saber que está bien, pero comienza a recordar varias situaciones que tuvo con Luís Fernando e inevitablemente llora. En la playa María Gracia va a despertar a Luís Fernando y recibe la noticia de que es llamada Dileidi. María Gracia se molesta muchísimo y discute con Luís Fernando y le propone dejar entonces todo hasta ahí como que si no hubiera pasado nada. Mientras tanto Egleé y Gladis le están mudando todo a Luís Fernando hacia el garaje y allí Egleé ve unos bocetos de Dileidi muy bellos y conversan y Egleé le dice a Gladis que no puede quitar el echo de que ellos dos estén muy enamorados. Felicita y Tatianita siguen lamentándose pero ahora en casa de la Nena por Luís Fernando. La Nena las regaña y le propone que busque otro partido pero ellas no quieren y la Nena le pone de ejemplo a Santiago pero ellas le cuenta que es gay. La Nena no lo puede creer porque el sale con Egleé. Cristinita llega al garaje en donde van a vivir María Gracia y Luís Fernando y entre tanta conversadera le dice a Gladis que Santiago es gay. Santiago que está en el aserradero de su abuelo le comenta la preocupación que tiene sobre la relación con Egleé y lo que ahora están diciendo de el. El abuelo lo apoya y le da ciertos consejos y confía de que Egleé es una persona sabía y sincera. Ya Egleé que está harta de esos comentario le confiesa a Cristinita que ella y Santiago son novios. En un principio no lo creía, pero Egleé se lo confirma y discuten, pero Egleé se impone y le dice que ella también tiene derecho de ser feliz, siempre apoyada de Gladis. Cristinita se va llorando. Luego de todo Egleé sube a buscarla para que comprenda. En la oficina Rómulo le comenta a Monchito sobre la relación que tiene Egleé con Santiago y la diferencia de años que llevan y la posibilidad de que después de cierto años la deje por otra más joven, y Egleé quede muy triste pero Monchito le recuerda que el está ahora casado con una muchacha mucho más joven que el y que ella como joven que es puede fijarse en un hombre joven también. Rómulo lo niega en todo momento y dice que eso no puede pasar. Da la casualidad que Betzaida está en una tienda de discos y es abordada por un hombre que queda prendada de ella y le saca conversación. Betzaida lo único que piensa que ella todavía tiene lo suyo aunque esté embarazada y que si Rómulo lo único que está es pendiente de Egleé porque ella no puede tener un Ángel que es el nombre del joven que acaba de abordarla.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 82: Escandalo, Orden de Captura y Peligro
programme.desc: Michelle está formando un escándalo a Diego Andrés por haber llegado tan tarde y en compañía de Marisela. Diego Andrés trata de explicar, pero Michelle no lo deja con los gritos destemplados. En ese momento llega el Comisario Escobar. Viene a buscar a Armando con una orden de captura. Le dicen que no saben nada de él. Luis Guillermo entra a la habitación de Inés, y llorando comienza a pensar en la última discusión en la que estaba presente Gabriela. Berta y Armando están en el apartamento. Berta le dice a Armando que no debe salir de allí porque seguramente lo andan buscando por el problema del incendio en la fábrica. Armando le dice que el es un hombre muy ocupado y que no puede estar encerrado.

programme.sub-title: Episodio 94: Barbara se Casa, Manuel Sufre
programme.desc: Salvador lleva a Bárbara al altar; Manuel sufre en la puerta de la iglesia. Cuando el padre pregunta si alguien se opone, Barbie mira hacia atrás esperando encontrar a Manuel, pero en vista de que no aparece es ella misma quien le dice al padre que continúe que nadie se opondrá. Bárbara se casa. Salvador se ve con Manuel después de la boda y le asegura que su hermana sigue enamorada de él.Durante la recepción Charo busca a Manuel, pero no lo encuentra. Fernando sigue a Charo hasta la habitación y hacen el amor. Luego, Fernando se marcha arrepentido por lo que acabó de pasar.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 94: El fantasma de la tia Laura.
programme.desc: Isadora brinda con Marisela y piensa que el hijo de Gabriel no nacerá. Una vez aclarado los puntos, Gabriel acepta quedarse en casa de Yolanda. Mirna y Reynaldo conversan de sus amores. Jesús va a buscar a Mirna. Víctor Manuel llora junto a su abuela por su mala vida y el está feliz de que ella sea su abuela pero no de su madre a quien no perdona. Cuando Isadora intenta agredir a Marisela una fuerte brisa hace que no brinden e Isadora ve a su difunta tía Laura, esto la aterra y se va corriendo creyendo que está loca. Flavia va al bar a buscar a Ramón, quien la recuerda. Abril cree que no es bueno estar en casa de sus padres pues no quiere pelear con su papá pues Ramón no la acepta y Berta se lo reclama entre llanto.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 137: Dileidi, Luis Fernando y el divorcio.
programme.desc: Gladis encuentra a su hija despidiendo a Aureliano muy alegre y le comenta que ella pensaba que la iba a encontrar muriéndose y Dileidi en ese momento rompe a llorar y abraza a Gladis diciéndole que si se está muriendo porque su novio acaba de casarse. Aureliano que llego a la bodega les cuenta tanto a Gabito como a Héctor como fue al rescate de Dileidi en la fiesta y como quedo como héroe. Dileidi le cuenta a Gladis que ella está muy mal porque sabe que su novio Luís Fernando se caso con la miss por compromiso y que se fue a la luna de miel muy afligido, pero Gladis le dice que eso no es como ella cree y no puede creer que Dileidi siendo tan inteligente se comporte de esa forma que no quiera entender lo que en realidad está pasando. Por otro lado, María Gracia llega a la habitación muy sexy y encuentra a Luís Fernando muy distraído, Luís Fernando vuelve en si y la ve así, pero María Gracia le dice que se siente muy mal, con nauseas y cansada y le pide disculpa a Luís Fernando porque ella lo único que quiere es dormir. Luís Fernando como un caballero le dice que no se preocupe, aunque lo que piensa es que malo comenzar un matrimonio así. Cristinita, Felicita y Tatianita que están en casa de Egleé comiendo torta y lamentándose por el casamiento de Luís Fernando, son interrumpida por la llega de Egleé y Santiago. Felicita y Tatianita opinan entonces tendrán que fijarse en Santiago que está soltero pero Cristinita les cuenta que Santiago es gay y tanto Felicita y Tatianita no lo pueden creer. Aristigueta y La Nena que llegaron también de la fiesta comentan sobre la misma. Aristigueta aprovecha para hablar de María José y Doroteo. La Nena se altera sobre algunos comentarios que hace y Aristigueta le opina que ella lo que está es celosa porque Doroteo anda con María José. La Nena se molesta aún más y le dice que ella no está celosa pero que debe recordar que Doroteo sigue siendo su marido legalmente y le da pena con sus amigos. María José y Doroteo conversan sobre Aristigueta y la Nena. María José se entera del papel que vio Doroteo en donde aparecen los terrenos y firmados por la Nena. María Antonia se da cuenta del error que cometió Aristigueta y le dice a Doroteo que como el sigue siendo esposo de La Nena entonces le pertenece la mitad de lo que le pertenece a la Nena en esos terrenos. Doroteo se alegra por esa información. Egleé se siente triste en el desayuno porque no se encuentra con Luís Fernando y se lo hace saber tanto a Gladis que llego como a Cristinita. Marco Aurelio en el trabajo le habla a Dileidi de Luís Fernando sin querer, es después que se da cuenta que hizo mal y le pide a Dileidi que no vaya a llorar y que lo perdone. Dileidi le hace saber que está bien, pero comienza a recordar varias situaciones que tuvo con Luís Fernando e inevitablemente llora. En la playa María Gracia va a despertar a Luís Fernando y recibe la noticia de que es llamada Dileidi. María Gracia se molesta muchísimo y discute con Luís Fernando y le propone dejar entonces todo hasta ahí como que si no hubiera pasado nada. Mientras tanto Egleé y Gladis le están mudando todo a Luís Fernando hacia el garaje y allí Egleé ve unos bocetos de Dileidi muy bellos y conversan y Egleé le dice a Gladis que no puede quitar el echo de que ellos dos estén muy enamorados. Felicita y Tatianita siguen lamentándose pero ahora en casa de la Nena por Luís Fernando. La Nena las regaña y le propone que busque otro partido pero ellas no quieren y la Nena le pone de ejemplo a Santiago pero ellas le cuenta que es gay. La Nena no lo puede creer porque el sale con Egleé. Cristinita llega al garaje en donde van a vivir María Gracia y Luís Fernando y entre tanta conversadera le dice a Gladis que Santiago es gay. Santiago que está en el aserradero de su abuelo le comenta la preocupación que tiene sobre la relación con Egleé y lo que ahora están diciendo de el. El abuelo lo apoya y le da ciertos consejos y confía de que Egleé es una persona sabía y sincera. Ya Egleé que está harta de esos comentario le confiesa a Cristinita que ella y Santiago son novios. En un principio no lo creía, pero Egleé se lo confirma y discuten, pero Egleé se impone y le dice que ella también tiene derecho de ser feliz, siempre apoyada de Gladis. Cristinita se va llorando. Luego de todo Egleé sube a buscarla para que comprenda. En la oficina Rómulo le comenta a Monchito sobre la relación que tiene Egleé con Santiago y la diferencia de años que llevan y la posibilidad de que después de cierto años la deje por otra más joven, y Egleé quede muy triste pero Monchito le recuerda que el está ahora casado con una muchacha mucho más joven que el y que ella como joven que es puede fijarse en un hombre joven también. Rómulo lo niega en todo momento y dice que eso no puede pasar. Da la casualidad que Betzaida está en una tienda de discos y es abordada por un hombre que queda prendada de ella y le saca conversación. Betzaida lo único que piensa que ella todavía tiene lo suyo aunque esté embarazada y que si Rómulo lo único que está es pendiente de Egleé porque ella no puede tener un Ángel que es el nombre del joven que acaba de abordarla.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 82: Escandalo, Orden de Captura y Peligro
programme.desc: Michelle está formando un escándalo a Diego Andrés por haber llegado tan tarde y en compañía de Marisela. Diego Andrés trata de explicar, pero Michelle no lo deja con los gritos destemplados. En ese momento llega el Comisario Escobar. Viene a buscar a Armando con una orden de captura. Le dicen que no saben nada de él. Luis Guillermo entra a la habitación de Inés, y llorando comienza a pensar en la última discusión en la que estaba presente Gabriela. Berta y Armando están en el apartamento. Berta le dice a Armando que no debe salir de allí porque seguramente lo andan buscando por el problema del incendio en la fábrica. Armando le dice que el es un hombre muy ocupado y que no puede estar encerrado.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: A Virginia le dan el alta del hospital y vuelve a la cárcel. Felipe le exige a la directora de la cárcel más seguridad para su cliente. Alejandra manda a pedir a Tony un informe sobre todas las cintas de seguridad, ya que ella comenzó a sospechar que Irene y Maribel se traen algo entre manos. Tony le entrega el informe y falta un video, Alejandra lo amenaza con despedirlo si no lo encuentra. Finalmente Maribel tuvo que devolver la cinta robada, pero Tony al ver que para ella significaba tanto esa cinta le hace una copia. Leonardo se encuentra con los Zamora en un bar y aparece Rodrigo. Leonardo se pone furioso y arma un escándalo en el restaurante y se retira. Rodrigo lo sigue y Leonardo le pega un puñetazo.

programme.title: Episodio 95: La Amenaza de Ramiro y la Verdad
programme.desc: Más Ramiro le dice a Bárbara que su vida será un infierno y le jura que nunca la tocará en la vida. Julio César le cuenta a Josefina que el matrimonio de Socorro fue una mentira para alejar a Salvador, pero la presiona para que no le cuente a Socorro.Manuel no acepta la propuesta de matrimonio de Charo, le dice que pueden ser amantes o amigos, pero no esposos.Ramiro le justifica a su madre que no se fueron de luna de miel porque Bárbara volvió a sufrir ataques de pánico.tarde Barbie lo ve chateando con mujeres a las que les propone salir. Ramiro se marcha y Bárbara aprovecha para llamar a Manuel, pero la que contesta el celular es Charo, quien le pide que los deje en paz.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 95: Retencion, Insultos y Sospechas en la Funeraria
programme.desc: Gabriel no permite que Marisela se vaya de la habitación. Ricardo va al hotel a buscar a Jesús. Berta sospecha que Yolanda estaba hablando de su Marisela. En la funeraria Giancarlos insulta y culpa a Jenniffer y a su padre por la muerte de su madre. A pesar de las explicaciones, Abril no perdona a Reynaldo. Gabriel insiste en retener a Marisela en la habitación, Daniel le reclama a Jesús el tener a una mujer en su habitación. Gabriel acaricia a Marisela. Jesús toca la puerta de una habitación el hotel. En el bar, Percy y las anfitrionas se burlan de Isabella que va a darle el pésame a Giancarlos. Los amigos de Giancarlos critican la presencia de Gabriela en la funeraria.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 138: Celos, Documentos Secretos y Enganos Amorosos
programme.desc: María Gracia se sigue sintiendo mal por lo de su embarazado y Luís Fernando trata de hacer que ella se sienta mejor, pero María Gracia aprovecha para reprocharle el que esté pensando en otra mujer en su luna de miel. Más tarde Luís Fernando y María Gracia pasean por la playa y están conversando muy animadamente, y ella le dice que Luís Fernando que ya lo perdonó pero le hace jurar que el no va a nombrar a Dileidi más nunca. Luís Fernando acepta pero lo que no sabe María Gracia que a Luís Fernando se le aparece Dileidi porque el la piensa en todo momento. Por otro lado en la oficina Dileidi conversa con Santiago, y ella recibe la llamada de Luís Fernando. Dileidi no lo puede creer, el la llama con una excusa sobre Santiago pero a la final si acepta que llamó porque no la puede dejar en pensar, pero cuando Dileidi le está contestando y le está diciendo que ella también piensa en el, aparece María Gracia. Luís Fernando le dice que solo habla con Santiago y María Gracia supuestamente lo saluda. Dileidi se da cuenta de lo que está pasando y opta por quedarse callada y trancar muy triste. Doroteo le pide el favor a Aureliano que le busque las copias del documentos en donde la Nena aparece como dueña de parte de los terrenos del centro comercial, pero Aureliano se niega por ser muy arriesgado. Aristigueta se presenta en la oficina de Marco Aurelio y le pide que le de esos documentos para hacerle uno arreglos, ya que el también sospecha de que María José ya sabe de esa existencia de los documentos y lo pueden descubrir. Por otro lado María José que se toma un café con Rosita le cuenta sobre la existencia del documento y no lo puede creer, porque Rosita está segurísima que la Nena no sabe nada. La Nena le cuenta a Pascuita sobre la actuación de Doroteo y María José en la fiesta, de cómo se divirtieron y lo mal que ella se sentía por ver esa situación. Mientras que Aristigueta espera que le busquen los documentos conversa con Marco Aurelio y son interrumpidos por Doroteo, y entre Aristigueta y Doroteo se suscita cierta conversación no muy agradable. Dileidi en la oficina le cuenta a Yenilú que Luís Fernando la llamó y Aureliano que está allí las oye y no lo puede creer y decide marcharse de allí. Yenilú sigue conversando con Dileidi sobre eso, y la quiere hacer entrar en razón sobre el matrimonio de Luís Fernando, y el papel que jugaría siendo la otra. Dileidi le promete a Yenilú que esa relación se acabo. Felicita que está en la sesión con Edén su psicólogo, recibe un mensaje de Aureliano para invitarla al cine. Dileidi en la oficina busca a Aureliano que está en el comedor y lo trata de invitar a salir, pero en eso llega Felicita de sorpresa y le dice que esta allí para aceptar la invitación al cine. Dileidi se queda muy sorprendida. Cristinita que se siente muy mal por que su mamá está saliendo con Santiago se lo conversa a Gladis, que por su parte le trata de dar consejos, pero Cristinita no le hace caso y sale en busca de Gerson porque si su padre se volvió a casar y su madre un novio más joven, pues ella tiene derecho de estar de amores con un vigilante. Egleé al llegar a la oficina le cuenta todo lo que le paso con Cristinita y que le confeso la verdad de su relación. Santiago no lo puede creer, pero mientras ellos conversan Rómulo lo único que hace es estar pendiente de ellos dos y Betzaida que trata de conversar con Rómulo se da cuenta de esto. Doroteo va a buscar a Ángel para que lo ayude con su problema que tiene con la Nena pero Ángel aprovecha para contarle que conoció una mujer bellísima y aparte le cuenta la historia de cómo fue a parar a brujo. Rosita le cuenta a la Nena sobre los documentos, la Nena no lo puede creer ya que ella no sabe absolutamente nada de esos dichosos documentos, pero son interrumpidas por Aristigueta y la Nena aprovecha para pedirle explicación a Aristigueta. Como siempre Aristigueta trata de esquivar todas la preguntas de la Nena pero hasta que Rosita intercede y le pregunta que si es verdadero o falso de la existencia de esos documentos. Doroteo que está consultándose con Ángel este le dice que si parece que esos documentos si son del difunto Aristigueta. Rosita y la Nena siguen esperando la respuesta de Aristigueta y el se pone muy nervioso y les muestra otros documentos. Rosita y La Nena lo aceptan pero no lo creen.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 83: Detenidos y boda suspendida
programme.desc: La llegada de Felix a la boda de Luis Guillermo sorprende a todos cuando detiene a Robert para llevarlo y someterlo a interrogatorios por la muerte de Inés, Berta se interpone en el camino de Daniela que va rumbo a su boda y trata de detenerla y cuando aparece la inspectora diciéndole que está detenida ambas se quedan sorprendidas. Armando se enfurece con Braulio que lo llama para exigirle que le pague o contará todo lo que sabe a la policía. Débora llega a casa de los Nuñez y les informa que Daniela ha sido detenida por haber agredido a la inspectora cuando ésta detenía a Berta y Luis Guillermo suspende definitivamente la boda.

Una familia que trabaja para él halla la gran esmeralda Titiguaca, desatando su odio: quema su casa y mata a un miembro. Días después, la familia Guerrero llega enviada por el banco para supervisar las minas, en medio de un clima de poder y violencia.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ortega es víctima de un intento de envenenamiento, sin embargo, al no lograrlo, se desata la guerra en la región. Ortega intenta sobornar a Alejandro, quien se niega y queda muy indignado. Días después, Olga es rescatada de un violador, gracias a Reina.

programme.title: Esmeraldas

Esa noche, en las fiestas, Alejandro propone repartir ganancias, idea que enfurece a Ortega. Horas después, el Esmeraldero le muestra al supuesto violador para que lo asesine, desatando tensión y dilemas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: La familia Guerrero busca adaptarse con trabajos, mientras Alejandro se involucra en el registro de esmeraldas para frenar la corrupción, lo que irrita a Ortega. Eduardo quiere dinero en las minas, pero su padre lo frena por temor a su ambición. Reina intenta negociar con su primo para entrar al negocio, pero él se niega a ayudarla.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Finalmente, los enemigos de Ortega encuentran a la esposa y a la hija, sin embargo, las mujeres son rescatadas por la Policía. Reina y Eduardo logran encontrar esmeraldas en la veta vieja, esto preocupa a Alejandro, pues teme por el bienestar de su hijo.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ortega despide a todos sus empleados de la mina, pues cree que lo quieren traicionar. Mientras tanto, Ortega secuestra al hijo de Jacinto Casas, otro de los grandes esmeralderos, sabiendo que ha sido este quien ha mandado por su esposa e hija. Al mismo tiempo, Olga conoce a Javier Arango, el nuevo Cura del pueblo, del cual queda completamente enamorada.

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and relaxes to some local jazz.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Puebla, Where the Good Cooks Are From
programme.desc: Puebla, Mexico: According to Tony, the best line cooks in NYC come from Mexico, so he travels to the Puebla, and enjoys mole sauces, toasted ant eggs, fried worms, and the legendary pulque (a slightly hallucinogenic drink made from cactus sap).

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Arcachon, France: Here, Bourdain first learned to love food as a child. Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fisherman's soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Culinary Travels With Dave Eckert
programme.desc: Explore incredible tastes of Chicago with Culinary Travels. From American gourmet and Spanish tapas to a festival that celebrates upper echelon chefs and top-shelf wine, it is time to get your napkins out for a whirlwind tour of Chicago.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Executive Chef Sabrina Stillhart shares the secrets behind a few of Gordon Ramsay's enticing signature dishes at Bread Street Kitchen, Gordon chooses an intern for his restaurant in Singapore, and we taste some whisky with "Mr. Whisky."

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.sub-title: Lai Po Heen and The Gulai House
programme.desc: Experience two remarkable restaurants in two vastly different settings: The Gulai House that is tucked deep in the Malaysian rainforest, and Lai Po Heen, a modern Cantonese-style kitchen with roots in ancient Cantonese tradition.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Perched majestically over the sparkling waters of the Andaman Sea, Kayuputi Langkawi is an elegant Asian fusion restaurant. Chef Gaetan Biesuz prepares a handful of Kayuputi's classic dishes and shares a few tips in the kitchen.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Phil receives a seat of honor at the Chef's Table at Baccanalia run by Chef Ivan Brehm. The restaurants Brehm has been a part of in his life have received a total of 11 Michelin Stars, and in our visit to Bacchanalia, we find out why.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Stephanie Carrier introduces us to the sensational Laguna Resort and Spa in Nusa Dua before Executive Chef Made Putra prepares a few of his memorable signature seafood dishes on the beach, and back at Arwana Restaurant.

programme.title: Welcome to My Strange City
programme.desc: Amid the dizzying heights of the Andes Mountains sits Laz Paz, Bolivia. The Mirandas, the friendly family Alexandra will be staying with, introduces her to elements of Bolivian culture that they keep close to their hearts. Also, meet famous Bolivian chola Glenda Yanez.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.sub-title: Papua New Guinea: The Fire Dance
programme.desc: When a person dies, or to celebrate a harvest or important visit, the Baining tribesmen create masks representing the Spirit of the Forest. A great fire is then lit in the village, and dancers adorning the masks dance around the fire, jumping on the embers to prove they are stronger than the flames.

programme.title: Lonely Planet: Best Parks Ever - America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: Best Parks to Escape the Crowds
programme.desc: Some of the best national parks attract thousands of spectators every day. If you're looking for a place to go where you won't bump elbows, then take a look at these solitary parks.

programme.title: Secrets of the National Parks
programme.desc: By foot, shuttle, and horseback, gain access to the scenic and geological wonders of Zion and Bryce Canyon National Parks. In Zion, embark on an ascent of Angel's Landing. In Bryce, climb sheer cliff walls, tube down the Virgin River, and gaze upon thousands of bizarre rock spires known as hoodoos.

programme.title: Secrets of the National Parks
programme.desc: Hawaii Volcanoes and Haleakala National Parks are two of the most extraordinary places on Earth. Here you can witness molten lava bubbling from the earth, catch a spectacular sunrise above the cloud-line, or take a dip into pools of paradise.

programme.title: The Cigar Vixen
programme.desc: Delicia reveals the many facets of Cuba's spectacular culture.

programme.title: Rudy Maxa's World
programme.desc: The Garden Route takes you along a rugged, gorgeous South African coastline. Surfers brave enormous waves and exotic birds watch visitors climb serpentine paths that rise above the coast amid seaside resort towns. Also, visit South Africa's lush wine country in the village of Franschhoek.

programme.title: Rudy Maxa's World
programme.desc: From the serene beauty of one man's architectural love poem to a woman, the Taj Mahal, to the crowded alleys of downtown New Delhi, India is a feast for the senses. Maxa discovers temples straight out of Disneyland and consults a street astrologer who tells him he will live a long life.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella Ri'chard
programme.desc: Mediterranean with Denella Ri'chard.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Las Vegas history shines at The Neon Museum and partake in the Art Car Party the night prior to the Art Car Parade. Farmacia Botanica has a cure for what ails you (or what you wish to ail someone else) and remember astronaut Deke Slayton.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Join us as we visit Frozen Dead Guy Days in Nederland, Colorado, one of the strangest festivals we have ever attended that honors a very dead Norwegian who resides in a shed on a hill above town under 1,200 pounds of dry ice.

programme.title: Savour Australia
programme.desc: In Darwin, Jason swims in the Crocodile Tank and visits Litchfield National Park. He also goes heli-pubbing, savours the delicious barra burger, then catches, and cooks, black pepper mud crab. Delicious!

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: The dishes Jeremy showcases are perfect for the family, beginning with a Malaysian Chicken Curry. Joe Swash focuses on Vegan Pad Thai. At the barbecue, Jeremy cooks up Korean BBQ Beef and Banchan, and for dessert, a Macha Mille Crepe Cake.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Proper Pub Food
programme.desc: We all enjoy eating outdoors in a beer garden, and Tom wants to show us how to create outdoor food properly. Chicken in a basket with a twist, a tasty fish burger, a delicious maple cake, extra special barbecued beef ribs… it is chow time.

programme.title: The Healthy Voyager's Global Kitchen

programme.title: Tastes Like Home

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: Gran Caffe Gambrinus energizes us for our stay in Naples where we first visit the tailoring masters at Rubinacci. We then learn how to make a proper Neapolitan pizza, visit Mount Vesuvius, make handmade paper, go fishing, and much more.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: In Uzbekistan, Mickela learns to play the doyra in Tashkent, visits the 700-year-old Siyob Bazaar along the ancient Silk Road in Samarkand, dances in the UNESCO World Heritage City of Bukhara, and shares a traditional dish of plov.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela jumps right in with the locals for dancing, music, and the building of Castells in Girona, Catalonia during the Feast of Saint John. She also visits Palamos to learn the iconic Sardana dance and celebrate the Habaneras Festival.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: At the White Stallion Ranch, Colleen and crew live like cowgirls by horseback riding, tending to the animals, and experiencing an authentic cookout. They also visit the Arizona-Sonora Desert Museum and the home of the original chimichanga.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.sub-title: ATV Rides, Snorkeling, and Taco Tours in Puerto Vallarta
programme.desc: Colleen's family takes an adventurous ATV ride through the stunning terrain of Mexico. They also go on a taco tour, visit Puerto Vallarta's famous Botanical Gardens, go parasailing, and experience a vibrant art tour.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: From chocolate in Switzerland to freshly caught fish in Florida, Colleen has explored food all over the world. Take a look back at some of the most unique and delicious foods and restaurants we have explored over the course of the series.

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.desc: From the Kalahari gates to Epupa Falls, through the Namibian and Skeleton Coasts, cross the most spectacular deserts and oases of Africa. Along the way, meet people with a thousand faces and lifestyles. By their side, he discovers this "wisdom of water," which is the real wealth of Namibia.

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.desc: Hitch a ride across the Sahara on a camel caravan and travel the ancient Salt Road. Among the few villages along this route, you will discover cultures that are nearly untouched by time. programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: Psychos in Love
programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. They fall in love and are happy being the family that slays together, until one day they come up against a plumber who also happens to be a cannibal.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure. Now, she must smoke out the whole school before it's too late.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: El ex Boina Verde, Justin Wise, cambia su vida de peligro por una placa de sheriff en un pueblo tranquilo en el corazón de las montañas Blue Ridge. Ahora más cerca de su ex esposa e hija, está listo para establecerse y abrazar una vida sin caos. Pero los problemas tienen una manera de seguirlo. Justo cuando comienza a adaptarse a la vida sencilla, un asesinato en la comunidad pone nerviosos a los residentes y reaviva una larga disputa entre dos de las familias más poderosas. A medida que Justin y sus ayudantes trabajan en el caso, se da cuenta de que hay más en su nuevo hogar de lo que parece. Los secretos se revelan y los motivos emergen, lo que lleva a Justin a una carrera contra el tiempo para resolver el caso antes de que la gente del pueblo tome la ley en sus propias manos.

programme.title: Cómo Encontrar a Alguien Que Sea para Siempre

programme.title: Encontrando El Amor en San Antonio

programme.title: Los Locos del Oro Negro
programme.desc: Onion Jack ha comprado un pedazo de tierra en el que asentarse, pero la propiedad sigue en posesión de los huérfanos del propietario original y es codiciada por el barón del petróleo local.

programme.title: La caravana de Oregón
programme.desc: Dos caravanas de carros convergen en lo que ahora es Kansas City, y se combinan para el empuje hacia el oeste de Oregón. En su búsqueda, los peregrinos experimentarán el calor del desierto, la nieve de las montañas, el hambre y los ataques de los indios.

programme.title: Pampa salvaje
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, un capitán del ejército intenta domar las llanuras abiertas de Argentina, dominadas por los indios y los bandidos. Para ello, el capitán trae a un grupo de mujeres para mantener contentos a sus soldados.

programme.title: Sitting Bull: Casta de guerreros
programme.desc: Sitting Bull, líder de los Sioux, se ve obligado por el general Custer a reaccionar violentamente, lo que lleva a la famosa batalla en Little Bighorn. Parrish, un amigo de los Sioux, intenta evitar la sangre derramada pero es acusado de colaborar con el enemigo. Sitting Bull intercede ante el presidente Grant para salvarlo.

programme.title: Rita En El West
programme.desc: La pequeña Rita tiene un sueño: sueña con un mundo mejor y cree que todo el mal del mundo se origina en el oro.

programme.title: ¡Más fuerte, muchachos
programme.desc: ¡Más fuerte, muchachos! - Un dúo de aviadores aterrizan en el corazón de la selva peruana, donde un especulador sin escrúpulos controla una preciosa fuente de esmeraldas y toda una comunidad minera. ¿Podrán enderezar el entuerto y, de paso, obtener algún beneficio?

programme.title: Los rebeldes de Arizona
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados se interpone en el camino de los ladrones de tierras que esperan el nuevo ferrocarril. Un duro pistolero les ayuda mientras atraviesan una serie de encuentros con la compañía ferroviaria, apaches, ladrones y traficantes de armas.

programme.title: Guerrero cheyenne
programme.desc: En su viaje hacia Oregón, Matthew y Rebecca se detienen en un puesto fronterizo donde un malentendido con los Cheyenne desencadena una tragedia. Rebecca y un guerrero herido, Hawk, son los únicos supervivientes. Con el invierno acercándose, ambos deberán superar sus diferencias para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Plomo sobre Dallas
programme.desc: La violencia estalla cuando unos hombres intentan apoderarse de las tierras de un ranchero para construir un nuevo ferrocarril.

programme.title: El pistolero de negro

programme.title: Al oeste de la división

programme.title: Yambaó
programme.desc: La historia se desarrolla en Cuba en 1850, cuando aún los negros eran esclavos en los cañaverales. En uno de éstos, el capitán Jorge (Ramón Gay) y su esposa Beatriz (Rosa Elena Durgel) viven felices en la casa mayor: esperan un hijo y sus esclavos viven tranquilos y en paz con ellos. Pero una noche de luna llena, el sonido de los tambores anuncia el regreso de Yambaó (Ninón Sevilla), nieta de la santera Caridad (Fedora Capdevila), quien murió aparentemente asesinada 15 años atrás, luego de ser desterrada por el antiguo propietario de la hacienda. El hacendado tomó la decisión a causa de las prácticas mágicas de Caridad y a la adversidad que trajo a la plantación, según los mismos negros. Yambaó creció en libertad y su regreso coincide con un nuevo brote de vómito negro, plaga que no había surgido en la plantación en décadas, y que todos atribuyen a su llegada. Yambaó en realidad no es mala, pero Caridad, quien no ha muerto y se refugia en una cueva, le ha llenado el corazón de odio y sed de venganza. Jorge se mantiene al margen de la práctica de la religión yoruba de sus esclavos, pero interviene cuando descubre que quieren matar a Yambaó.

programme.title: Sombra Verde
programme.desc: Con el propósito de utilizar raíces de barbasco en la producción de cortisona, una empresa farmacéutica envía a un científico a investigar las posibilidades de explotación en Veracruz, pero el hombre se pierde en la selva y vive una extraña aventura.
